blog.title: Best Road Trips from Delhi for a Weekend Getaway: Top Places to Explore
blog.content:
Planning a quick escape from the busy streets of Delhi? A weekend road trip from Delhi is a great way to relax, explore beautiful destinations, and spend quality time with friends or family. From peaceful hill stations and scenic lakes to historical cities and adventure destinations, there are plenty of exciting places to visit near the capital.

The best road trips from Delhi offer something for every type of traveller. Whether you love mountains, nature, history, or adventure, you can find a destination that matches your interests and budget.

In this guide, we will explore 10 best weekend getaways near Delhi by car, along with their distances, travel times, popular attractions, and useful travel tips to help you plan a memorable journey.

1. Delhi to Jaipur – Explore the Beautiful Pink City

Distance: Approximately 280 km Travel Time: 5–6 hours Best Time to Visit: October to March Ideal Duration: 2 Days

Jaipur is one of the most popular weekend road trips from Delhi. Known as the Pink City, Jaipur is famous for its beautiful forts, royal palaces, colourful markets, and traditional Rajasthani food.

The journey from Delhi to Jaipur is comfortable, with good highway connectivity. Once you reach Jaipur, you can explore historical monuments, enjoy local food, and shop for traditional clothes and handicrafts.

Best Places to Visit in Jaipur

  • Hawa Mahal: A famous palace known for its unique windows and architecture.

  • Amber Fort: A beautiful historical fort offering amazing views.

  • City Palace: A royal palace showcasing Jaipur's rich history.

  • Jal Mahal: A scenic palace located in the middle of Man Sagar Lake.

  • Johari Bazaar: A popular shopping destination for jewellery and traditional items.

Jaipur is an excellent destination for families, couples, and history lovers looking for a memorable weekend getaway.

2. Delhi to Rishikesh – Adventure and Natural Beauty

Distance: Approximately 250 km Travel Time: 5–7 hours Best Time to Visit: October to April Ideal Duration: 2–3 Days

Rishikesh is one of the best road trips from Delhi with friends, especially for people who enjoy adventure and nature. Located in Uttarakhand, Rishikesh is famous for its beautiful river views, peaceful surroundings, yoga centres, and adventure activities.

The drive from Delhi to Rishikesh offers changing landscapes, especially as you approach the foothills. Visitors can enjoy riverside cafés, explore temples, or simply relax beside the Ganga River.

Best Things to Do in Rishikesh

  • River Rafting: Enjoy rafting during the permitted season with authorised operators.

  • Ram Jhula: Explore the famous bridge area and nearby attractions.

  • Triveni Ghat: Attend the beautiful evening Ganga Aarti.

  • Neer Garh Waterfall: Visit a scenic waterfall surrounded by nature.

  • Riverside Cafés: Relax while enjoying views of the Ganga River.

Rishikesh is perfect for travellers looking for adventure, relaxation, and a refreshing weekend escape.

3. Delhi to Agra – Discover India's Historical Beauty

Distance: Approximately 230 km Travel Time: 3.5–5 hours Best Time to Visit: October to March Ideal Duration: 1–2 Days

Agra is among the best short road trips from Delhi for people interested in history and architecture. The city is home to the world-famous Taj Mahal and several beautiful Mughal monuments.

Travelling from Delhi to Agra through the Yamuna Expressway is relatively convenient, making it suitable for a short weekend trip. You can explore historical attractions, enjoy traditional food, and learn about India's rich cultural heritage.

Best Places to Visit in Agra

  • Taj Mahal: One of the most famous monuments in the world.

  • Agra Fort: A magnificent historical fort built during the Mughal period.

  • Mehtab Bagh: A peaceful garden offering beautiful Taj Mahal views.

  • Itmad-ud-Daulah's Tomb: A beautiful monument known for its detailed design.

  • Fatehpur Sikri: A historical Mughal city located near Agra.

Agra is ideal for couples, families, and photography lovers who want to explore historical attractions.

4. Delhi to Mussoorie – A Beautiful Mountain Escape

Distance: Approximately 300 km Travel Time: 7–9 hours Best Time to Visit: March to June and October to November Ideal Duration: 2–3 Days

Mussoorie is one of the most beautiful hill stations near Delhi for a weekend. Popularly known as the Queen of Hills, Mussoorie attracts visitors with its green mountains, pleasant weather, beautiful viewpoints, and peaceful atmosphere.

The journey becomes more scenic as you enter the mountain roads. Mussoorie is an excellent destination for escaping the summer heat and enjoying fresh mountain air.

Best Places to Visit in Mussoorie

  • Kempty Falls: A popular waterfall surrounded by natural beauty.

  • Mall Road: A lively area for shopping, walking, and enjoying local food.

  • Gun Hill: A viewpoint offering beautiful mountain scenery.

  • Lal Tibba: A famous viewpoint with Himalayan views on clear days.

  • Company Garden: A peaceful garden suitable for families.

Mussoorie is a wonderful destination for romantic getaways, family holidays, and nature lovers.

5. Delhi to Nainital – Enjoy a Peaceful Lake Holiday

Distance: Approximately 320 km Travel Time: 7–9 hours Best Time to Visit: March to June and October to November Ideal Duration: 2–3 Days

Nainital is one of the most popular scenic road trips near Delhi. Surrounded by beautiful hills and centred around Naini Lake, this destination is perfect for travellers who enjoy peaceful surroundings and natural beauty.

The town offers several activities, including boating, sightseeing, shopping, and exploring viewpoints. Its pleasant atmosphere makes it a favourite destination for couples and families.

Best Places to Visit in Nainital

  • Naini Lake: Enjoy boating and beautiful lakeside views.

  • Naina Devi Temple: A famous religious attraction near the lake.

  • Snow View Point: A scenic viewpoint offering mountain views.

  • Mall Road: A popular area for shopping and enjoying local food.

  • Eco Cave Gardens: An interesting attraction for families and children.

Nainital is an excellent choice for travellers looking for relaxation, beautiful landscapes, and memorable family moments.

6. Delhi to Lansdowne – A Quiet Getaway Surrounded by Nature

Distance: Approximately 270 km Travel Time: 6–8 hours Best Time to Visit: March to June and September to November Ideal Duration: 2 Days

Lansdowne is a peaceful hill station in Uttarakhand and one of the best weekend getaways near Delhi by car for travellers who prefer less crowded destinations.

The town is surrounded by pine forests, beautiful hills, and quiet roads. Unlike popular tourist destinations, Lansdowne offers a calm atmosphere where visitors can enjoy nature without too much noise.

Best Places to Visit in Lansdowne

  • Bhulla Tal Lake: A peaceful lake surrounded by greenery.

  • Tip-in-Top Viewpoint: A beautiful location for enjoying mountain views.

  • St. Mary's Church: A historic church with charming architecture.

  • Garhwali Museum: A museum showcasing military history.

  • Tarkeshwar Mahadev Temple: A peaceful temple surrounded by forests outside the town.

Lansdowne is ideal for couples, nature lovers, and travellers looking for a relaxing weekend.

7. Delhi to Neemrana – A Royal Weekend Experience

Distance: Approximately 120 km Travel Time: 2–3 hours Best Time to Visit: October to March Ideal Duration: 1–2 Days

Neemrana is one of the closest and most convenient short road trips from Delhi. Located in Rajasthan, this destination is famous for its beautiful heritage fort and royal atmosphere.

If you have limited time but still want to enjoy a refreshing getaway, Neemrana is a great option. The destination is especially popular among couples and families looking for a peaceful stay away from city life.

Best Things to Do in Neemrana

  • Neemrana Fort Palace: Explore the beautiful heritage property.

  • Heritage Stay: Experience traditional architecture and royal hospitality.

  • Photography: Capture beautiful views of the fort and surrounding landscape.

  • Local Exploration: Discover nearby markets and local culture.

  • Relaxation: Enjoy a peaceful weekend at a heritage hotel.

Neemrana is a good option for a quick weekend road trip from Delhi without spending too much time travelling.

8. Delhi to Jim Corbett – Explore Wildlife and Nature

Distance: Approximately 250–280 km Travel Time: 5–7 hours Best Time to Visit: November to June, depending on the safari zone Ideal Duration: 2–3 Days

Jim Corbett is one of the most exciting places to visit near Delhi by road for wildlife enthusiasts. Located in Uttarakhand, Jim Corbett National Park is famous for its forests, wildlife, and beautiful natural surroundings.

Visitors can enjoy wildlife safaris in permitted zones, explore nearby attractions, and stay at nature resorts. It is an excellent destination for travellers who enjoy outdoor experiences.

Best Things to Do in Jim Corbett

  • Jungle Safari: Explore permitted safari zones with an authorised guide.

  • Wildlife Photography: Look for deer, elephants, birds, and other wildlife.

  • Garjiya Devi Temple: Visit the famous temple near the Kosi River.

  • Corbett Museum: Learn about Jim Corbett and the area's history.

  • Nature Stay: Relax at a resort surrounded by greenery.

Jim Corbett is ideal for families, wildlife lovers, and adventure enthusiasts looking for something different.

9. Delhi to Chandigarh – Explore a Beautiful Planned City

Distance: Approximately 250 km Travel Time: 4.5–6 hours Best Time to Visit: October to March Ideal Duration: 2 Days

Chandigarh is one of the easiest weekend trips from Delhi by car. Known for its clean roads, beautiful gardens, and modern architecture, Chandigarh offers a relaxing city experience.

The journey is relatively straightforward, and the city has several attractions suitable for families, couples, and groups of friends.

Best Places to Visit in Chandigarh

  • Sukhna Lake: A beautiful lake for boating and evening walks.

  • Rock Garden: A unique garden featuring sculptures made from recycled materials.

  • Rose Garden: A peaceful garden filled with different varieties of roses.

  • Elante Mall: A popular shopping and entertainment destination.

  • Sector 17 Market: A lively area for shopping and dining.

Chandigarh is a great choice for travellers who prefer comfortable travel, sightseeing, shopping, and relaxing city breaks.

10. Delhi to Bharatpur – A Peaceful Nature and Birdwatching Trip

Distance: Approximately 220 km Travel Time: 4–5 hours Best Time to Visit: October to March Ideal Duration: 1–2 Days

Bharatpur is one of the best budget road trips from Delhi for nature lovers and birdwatching enthusiasts. Located in Rajasthan, the city is famous for Keoladeo National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

The park attracts many species of birds, including migratory birds during the winter season. Visitors can explore the park by walking, cycling, or using permitted local transport.

Best Places to Visit in Bharatpur

  • Keoladeo National Park: A famous destination for birdwatching.

  • Lohagarh Fort: A historic fort known for its strong structure.

  • Bharatpur Palace: A beautiful example of traditional architecture.

  • Government Museum: Explore historical artefacts and local heritage.

  • Local Markets: Discover traditional products and local food.

Bharatpur is perfect for nature photography, peaceful travel, and affordable weekend holidays.

Best Time to Plan a Weekend Road Trip from Delhi

The best time for a road trip from Delhi depends on the destination and the type of experience you want.

Summer (March to June)

Summer is a good time to visit hill stations such as Mussoorie, Nainital, and Lansdowne. These destinations generally offer cooler weather than Delhi, making them popular for summer holidays.

However, weekends can be crowded, so booking hotels in advance is recommended.

Monsoon (July to September)

The monsoon season brings beautiful greenery to many destinations. Places like Rishikesh and Lansdowne look especially scenic during this period.

However, heavy rainfall can cause landslides, slippery roads, and travel delays in hilly areas. River rafting and some outdoor activities may also be restricted.

Always check weather forecasts and local travel advisories before planning a monsoon road trip.

Winter (October to February)

Winter is one of the best seasons for exploring Jaipur, Agra, Neemrana, Bharatpur, and Chandigarh.

The cooler weather makes sightseeing more comfortable. Winter is also a popular season for birdwatching in Bharatpur.

If you plan to visit hill stations, carry warm clothes and check road conditions before travelling.

Essential Tips for a Safe and Comfortable Road Trip

Planning ahead can make your weekend road trip from Delhi more enjoyable and stress-free.

  1. Check Your Vehicle: Inspect the tyres, brakes, engine oil, and other important parts before starting your journey.

  2. Start Early: Leaving Delhi early in the morning can help you avoid heavy traffic.

  3. Plan Your Route: Use a navigation app to check road conditions, traffic, and alternative routes.

  4. Book Accommodation: Reserve your hotel in advance, especially during weekends and holidays.

  5. Carry Essentials: Keep drinking water, snacks, medicines, chargers, and a first-aid kit.

  6. Follow Traffic Rules: Maintain safe speeds and avoid risky overtaking, especially on mountain roads.

  7. Take Regular Breaks: Stop during long drives to avoid tiredness.

  8. Check Weather Updates: Always review the forecast before travelling to hill stations or wildlife destinations.

Following these simple tips can help you enjoy a safe and memorable road trip.

How to Plan a Budget Road Trip from Delhi

You do not need a large budget to enjoy a weekend getaway. With proper planning, you can explore several beautiful destinations without spending too much money.

Choose nearby destinations such as Neemrana, Agra, or Bharatpur to reduce fuel expenses. Travelling with friends can also help you share transportation and accommodation costs.

Look for budget hotels, guesthouses, or homestays instead of expensive resorts. Eating at well-reviewed local restaurants and avoiding unnecessary shopping can also help control your expenses.

For an affordable trip, focus on destinations with free or low-cost attractions, such as public gardens, viewpoints, markets, and nature walks.

A well-planned budget road trip from Delhi can be just as enjoyable as an expensive holiday.

Conclusion

A weekend road trip from Delhi is one of the easiest ways to take a break from everyday life and explore beautiful destinations. Whether you want to enjoy the mountains of Mussoorie, experience adventure in Rishikesh, discover Jaipur's royal history, or relax near Naini Lake, there are plenty of exciting options within driving distance of Delhi.

The best road trips from Delhi depend on your interests, budget, and available time. If you enjoy historical places, Jaipur and Agra are excellent choices. For nature and relaxation, Nainital and Lansdowne are worth exploring. Adventure lovers can consider Rishikesh and Jim Corbett.

Choose your favourite destination, plan your route, pack your essentials, and get ready for a memorable weekend getaway.
